purpose: Analyze why the premature-action safety gate does not generalize without tuning on VALIDATION or using private oracle values in a model/guard.

trigger.e10g_full_result: Full DEV+VALIDATION remains not promotable because premature_action_rate=0.25.
trigger.repeated_full_pattern: E10d, E10e and E10g full remeasurements preserve the same safety regression.

allowed_inputs: repository implementation and documentation that does not contain private oracle material
forbidden_inputs: private expected-path values in a model or guard
analysis_questions: Why do E10d/E10e/E10g full runs preserve premature_action_rate=0.25 despite DEV-only success?
Which general safety design assumption failed?
What class-level redesign can be proposed without using protected validation feedback?
What must be true before any future full DEV+VALIDATION remeasurement or integration gate?

must_include: reason the visible-output guards did not generalize
